summary: Explains the Animation Budget Allocator plugin, which caps game-thread animation time by throttling, interpolating or reducing work on SkeletalMeshComponentBudgeted components; covers setup in Blueprint or C++, the debug graph and stat overlay, per-platform budgets via scalability ini, the IAnimationBudgetAllocator C++ API and the full a.Budget.* cvar list.
gotchas: Plugin must be enabled and the editor restarted
Both the Enable Animation Budget node and a.Budget.Enabled must be on for it to run
Mesh Component Class must be set to SkeletalMeshComponentBudgeted (or SetDefaultSubobjectClass in the ACharacter constructor)
Registering a component disables its default tick and URO

summary: Shows how to install the Android toolchain (Android Studio, command-line tools, SDK/NDK/JDK, env vars) automatically with Turnkey, from the editor's Platforms > SDK Management menu or RunUAT on the command line, plus cleanup of old installs and troubleshooting.
keys: Platforms > SDK Management > Android > Install Sdk
gotchas: Needs a clean system with no previous Android Studio installs or Android env vars
Emulator setup step may fail with 'Android SDK not found' even though the SDK installed fine
Target API level SDK is only downloaded when you first package for it
Log out and back in to finalize environment variables

summary: Short guide to making an Apple TV visible to the editor's Device Manager or Xcode over a local network, including Connect to IP when it is not detected.
gotchas: Recent tvOS devices have no USB port; Ethernet is recommended over WiFi

summary: Walkthrough of the legacy bundled PSO cache workflow on Android: enable shared shader code, set NeedsShaderStableKeys, run a -logPSO build via a Project Launcher profile, pull CollectedPSOs from the device, expand them with ShaderPipelineCacheTools and place the result in Build/Android/PipelineCaches.
gotchas: Legacy manual method for UE 5.2 and earlier; PSO precaching (5.3+) is recommended
More gathered PSOs lengthen startup time
Closing the game from the Project Launcher may not save logged PSO data
Regather when locations change significantly

summary: Reference for Android device profiles (Android_Low/Mid/High, GPU-family profiles), config override order, MatchProfile device-matching rules and Vulkan enablement; also explains scalability groups (sg.* values 0-3), overriding AndroidScalability.ini, and changing scalability at runtime via console, Blueprint Get Game User Settings, or UGameUserSettings in C++.
gotchas: Matching stops at the first rule that matches, so rule order matters
Vulkan only recommended on Android 9+
Prefer changing scalability in *Scalability.ini over per-cvar tweaks in device profiles so Preview Rendering Level stays accurate

summary: Hub page: links to Android Studio debugging, AGDE in Visual Studio, Android File Server, and the Android Emulator.

Explains how to debug UE apps on iOS/tvOS with Xcode: cook content (in the editor or via BuildCookRun, or import cooked data), inject it with Prepare for Debugging (WrangleContentForDebugging), then run from Xcode; also a manual DebugGame scheme alternative.
gotchas: Requires a macOS machine with Xcode
Needs a code signing certificate and provisioning profile or deploy fails
Xcode cannot cook content

summary: Covers installing the Android Game Development Extension for Visual Studio 2022, checking JDK env vars, launching a packaged Android build under the debugger with DebugGame/Android, attaching to a running process, and an Android 14 SIGBUS fix.
gotchas: Requires AGDE 23.1.82 or higher and Visual Studio 2022
AGDE cannot cook content; package an APK first
SIGILL errors can be skipped with F5
Android 14 asserts need a SIGBUS process handle command

summary: Shows how to debug C++ and Java code of an Android UE build in Android Studio by opening the Intermediate/Android/APK/Gradle project, using Dual debug type and LLDB data formatters; also bDontBundleLibrariesInAPK to speed iteration.
gotchas: Shipping builds still bundle libUnreal.so in the APK
Use TEXT("string") rather than L("string")
Debugger attach can take a long time on large projects

summary: Explains creating an Android Studio virtual device sized for UE (4 GB+ RAM, storage twice the game size, API 35 image), enabling Vulkan/GPU acceleration in AndroidFeatures.ini, launching the emulator, deploying UE builds to it, and debugging with matching host architecture.
gotchas: Default virtual devices have ~256 MB RAM; set at least 4 GB
System image must support API 35 to run arm64, otherwise target x86-64
App architecture must match the host architecture to debug
Profile name differs from running instance name

summary: Describes frame pacing on mobile: Android's Swappy library (default since 5.2), the device-profile parameters that control frame pacing on iOS and Android, and the FPlatformRHIFramePacer C++ functions.
gotchas: bEnableDynamicMaxFPS only affects iOS (120Hz)

summary: Hub page introducing Gauntlet, a framework for running Unreal sessions that perform tests and validate results across platforms, with the optional Gauntlet plugin TestController; links to overview, running tests, and Gauntlet Controller pages.
Explains where the generated AndroidManifest.xml lives and how to add extra tags and settings to its manifest, application and GameActivity nodes through the Advanced APK Packaging project settings.
gotchas: Never edit AndroidManifest.xml directly; use project settings
Manifest only exists after packaging or deploying

summary: Google Play specifics for in-app purchases via OnlineSubsystemGooglePlay: subscription product ID prefixing and plan/offer entries, server validation, consume vs acknowledge finalization, receipts, subscription expiry, testing and the required permissions/config.
gotchas: Subscription product IDs must be prefixed with s-
Non-acknowledged transactions are refunded after a period
On-device validation is not safe; subscription expiry is not available on device

summary: App Store specifics for in-app purchases via OnlineSubsystemIOS: querying products, validation, finalizing transactions, receipt persistence and OnUnexpectedPurchaseReceipt, restore, testing with StoreKit/sandbox, and required config.
gotchas: Finalized transactions no longer produce receipts; keep your own record
Does not work with a wildcard provisioning profile
Not finalizing transactions may hurt device performance

summary: Quickstart for tracing an Android build with Unreal Insights: enable AndroidFileServer, package and deploy, push a UECommandline.txt with trace arguments via UnrealAndroidFileTool, open the live session, and pull recorded .trace files.
gotchas: Source builds must compile Programs/UnrealInsights if the exe is missing

summary: Lists SDK, macOS and Xcode versions and minimum compatible Apple devices for iOS/iPadOS/tvOS development, with a version history table per UE release.
gotchas: Targets iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 17 or later
App Store uploads require Xcode 26 / base SDK 26 since April 28, 2026
Selecting iOS SDK 15/16 needs Metal shader stripping disabled
A8/A8X devices not supported

summary: Quick start for building a UE project for iOS/iPadOS/tvOS: set up Xcode components and command line tools, create a mobile project, register the device, use Automatic Code Signing with a Bundle Identifier, and Quick Launch or Package Project.
gotchas: Requires a Mac with Xcode and an Apple Developer account
Command Line Tools path must be set or the editor won't open
Metal Toolchain component required

summary: How-to for scheduling local (not remote) notifications on Android and iOS in Blueprint using Register for Remote Notifications, Get Launch Notification and Schedule Local Notifications from Now.
gotchas: Beta feature
Only local notifications, not server-sent
iOS requires a source build and a C++ project

summary: Explains adding iOS localization folders ({Lang}.lproj with InfoPlist.strings and Localizable.strings) under Build/IOS/Resources/Localizations so plist and NSLocalizedString strings are translated when packaged.
gotchas: At least one language's localization files are required before submitting to Apple

summary: Manual alternative to Turnkey: install a specific Android Studio version, add command-line tools, reset env vars, run SetupAndroid to install the NDK, and set SDK/NDK/JDK paths for older engine versions.
gotchas: Keep the default Android Studio install location or SetupAndroid can't find files
UE 5.3+ uses JBR (OpenJDK 17); uninstalling may break JRE for UE 5.2 and older
Close the editor and Epic Games Launcher first

summary: Deprecated reference page on mobile feature levels (OpenGL ES 3.2, Android Vulkan, Metal 2.0), Mobile HDR, enabling mobile deferred shading, and the desktop renderer on mobile; points to replacement pages.
gotchas: Page is deprecated and will be removed
Desktop renderer is Experimental on Android Vulkan, Beta on iOS
Restart the editor after changing renderer settings

summary: Compares mobile forward and deferred shading (set with r.Mobile.ShadingPath): benefits, drawbacks, when to use each, deferred lighting features, rendering limitations, tile-memory behavior per GPU and Mali GBuffer limits.
gotchas: Deferred has no MSAA
Deferred with precomputed lighting only supports DefaultLit and Unlit
Translucency always uses forward shading
Lit decals unsupported with static lighting in deferred

summary: Mobile rendering optimization guide: performance budgeting, on-device stat commands, normal maps vs dense meshes, draw call and material ID reduction, material and texture cost, package size vs boot time settings, Size Map, Statistics, and Memreport.
gotchas: Four-finger-tap console only in Development builds
Size Map requires the AssetManagerEditor plugin and shows pre-cook sizes
Draw call counts differ between PIE and device

summary: Lists factors that affect iOS packaged size: Shipping vs Development configuration, accidentally referenced content, disabling Slate with bUsesSlate in C++ projects, and memory tools Obj List and LLM.
gotchas: Packaging cooks all content, even unreferenced; Launch cooks only referenced maps
Disconnected nodes and unused default textures still count as references

summary: Explains Pipeline State Objects in D3D12/Vulkan/Metal, why creating them on demand causes hitches, and what PSO caches are; links to PSO Precaching, bundled PSO cache creation, and State Object Database pages.
gotchas: Creating a PSO on demand can take 100+ ms
Ray tracing PSOs are not supported for PSO caching (UE 5.0)

summary: Hub page: links to signing for Google Play, Google Play Asset Delivery, packaging Android projects, the Android Configuration Rules System, and device profiles/scalability for Android.
Steps to produce an .ipa via File > Package Project > iOS on Windows or macOS, and install it on a device through Xcode's Devices and Simulators.

Mobile content guidelines: lighting performance tiers (LDR, Basic, Full HDR, HDR with per-pixel sun), Shader Complexity view, r.MobileContentScaleFactor, Material Quality Level and Quality Switch, mobile material options, and mobile rendering and shader permutation project settings.
gotchas: r.MaterialQualityLevel 1 is High and 2 is Medium
Changing mobile shader permutation settings requires an editor restart
Disabling a needed permutation breaks lighting with an on-screen warning

summary: Guide to Android platform profilers (Android Performance Analyzer, Arm Performance Studio components, Android Studio Profiler tasks, Perfetto, Snapdragon Profiler) for UE builds, including debuggable vs profileable builds, symbol setup and correlating with Unreal Insights.
gotchas: Several tools need a debuggable build (For Distribution off)
Frame Advisor needs Android 11+ and PSO caching disabled
Native allocation tracking needs the Ansi allocator override, which changes allocation behavior
Perfetto UI needs Android 11 (API 30)+

summary: Guide to profiling UE iOS builds with Xcode (Debug Navigator gauges, Metal Frame Debugger, Organizer, Memory Graph Debugger) and Instruments templates (Time Profiler, Metal System Trace, Allocations, Power Profiler), plus dSYM generation and common iOS performance patterns.
gotchas: Requires an Apple Silicon Mac and a physical device
Designed for iPad on Mac results don't reflect device performance
Instruments tracks libc malloc, not UE's binned allocator, unless the Ansi override is used

summary: Covers Android binary size reduction: default UE5 dead-code elimination, bEnableAdvancedBinaryCompression with MinSDKVersion 23 (GNU hash, APS relocation compression, direct .so loading via bExtractNativeLibs) and 28 (RELR).
gotchas: Advanced optimizations need minimum SDK 23 or 28 and must be enabled manually
For APKs under Google Play's 150 MB cellular limit, page recommends against bExtractNativeLibs=false

summary: Overview of tools for growing teams: supported version control (Perforce, Git LFS, SVN, Diversion), Unreal Game Sync, installed builds, modules and IWYU, UAT BuildCookRun/BuildGraph/Horde/UBA, multi-process cook, Virtual Assets, shared DDC with Zen, and automated tests.
gotchas: Set up version control before anyone starts working on assets or code

summary: Steps to trust an Apple device with a Mac, enable Developer Mode, register its UUID with an Apple Developer team, and verify the connection in Xcode, with fixes for common Xcode warnings.
gotchas: Developer Mode required on iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 16+
Personal Team builds expire after seven days
Unregistered devices fail with a provisioning profile error

summary: Guide to creating a new mobile project (Mobile target, Scalable preset) and what those defaults disable, then summarized Android setup via Turnkey and Configure Now, iOS setup via Xcode and Automatic Code Signing, and Quick Launch on-device testing.
keys: Platforms > SDK Management > Android > Install SDK
gotchas: Some platform configuration features need a C++ project
Shipping to the App Store needs a Mac with Xcode
Quick Launch builds are unoptimized; use packaged builds for performance testing

summary: Describes the Android Launch Images project settings (splash screen and OBB download backgrounds for portrait/landscape) and how to configure them.
Shows how to enable the Android OS virtual keyboard for UMG text input instead of the popup dialog, with a sample TextBox widget, and the Android.NewKeyboard cvar to force either mode.
gotchas: App must keep input elements from being hidden behind the keyboard
